Name: Toys for Children
Author: monteso
Description:
WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE


For a family with two toddlers there is a sure lack of toys and playthings scattered about the place. This mod replaces the wizard couch, birch dresser,
and two house plants with a doll house and paint stand,a rocking horse, a toy yellow truck and a jack n' a box. The dollhouse and jack n' box are a recolor of the ones from Jas's room. The doll house is rotatable.

Possibility for future additions, leave a comment if there's something you would like added and its within reason.  Just remember the more items I add the more items i have to sacrifice, until it becomes possible for adding new content.
